decision: 2026-11-17 user directive: optimize engineering efficiency before locking the baseline (rc1 deferred)

status.baseline: acoustic_kv16 DP2 (2 train + 2 infer) 100-step = 74.7641 s/step, finite_dp2_efficiency_audited, 12800 exposures; SLURP TEST acoustic parity exact (269x60, prob/logit err 0.0)
status.blocked_on: none for the efficiency baseline; the only remaining lever with positive expected gain is reference_actor_overlap (epoch-1 only, ~1.1x full run) and it is a structural build, not yet started
status.note: capacity disproven (8x token = +2.70%); acoustic_kv16 is the measured DP2 baseline; MINDS transfer-domain parity (10/259) is a transfer-eval item, not a source-domain baseline blocker

topology.pattern: 2 training cards + 2 inference cards (2026-11-17 user directive: the 100-step efficiency baseline uses 2-card training + 2-card inference)
topology.matched_baseline_note: the batch32 study already measured DP2 + dual TP1 at 32q/131072t over 100 steps (12800 real exposures, 84.17 s/step) and only gained 2.70% over 4q/16384t. This DP2 topology is retained for a future NON-capacity candidate (actor / acoustic batching / reference-actor overlap); capacity itself is fixed at the measured optimum.

baseline.redundancy: the per-candidate question boilerplate (~20 tokens) is identical across all 60 questions, ~42% of the context
baseline.measured_negative_result: docs/engineering/context-service-batch32-100step-study-v1.md: batch4 (4q/16384t) -> batch32 (32q/131072t, 8x tokens) at gpu_memory_utilization=.4 improved throughput by only 2.70% (86.44->84.17 s/step); actor unchanged. Evidence: srv .../service-batch32-v1-prepared/package/service-0.json = 32/131072. So capacity is saturated; the cost is the serial acoustic tower plus the 48% actor.

engine_token_budget.note: 2026-11-17 correction: the batch32 study already raised max_batch_tokens 16384->131072 (8x) AND max_batch_queries 4->32, at gpu_memory_utilization=.4, for only +2.70% (86.44->84.17 s/step). Evidence: srv/multimodal-jev-xingchao/operations/service-batch32-v1-prepared/package/service-0.json shows 32/131072 vs the micro8 baseline 4/16384. 65536 is strictly below the tested 131072, so this lever is not the efficiency baseline; capacity is fixed at the already-proven 32q/131072t.

engine_memory_utilization.note: 131072 tokens already ran 100 steps at gpu_memory_utilization=.4 (the batch32 study completed). Raising to .6 has no demonstrated need and is dropped.

template_dedup.change: state the question boilerplate once in the system prompt; each candidate keeps only id + definition + marker
template_dedup.reason: 42% of the context is verbatim-repeated boilerplate
template_dedup.note: semantically equivalent but changes the prompt; must be a separate validated task-definition candidate, not folded into the engineering baseline

actor_optimization.change: reduce the non-rollout actor cost (FSDP/all-reduce, microbatch schedule, Python dispatch overhead)
actor_optimization.reason: actor is 48.26% of the step (~40.6 s/step in DP2) and does not improve with inference batching; it is the single largest remaining term

acoustic_batching.change: batch the acoustic tower across recordings instead of the current serial per-recording forward
acoustic_batching.reason: context_segmented_audio_candidate.segmented_audio_forward is intentionally serial; only the LM prefill is batched, which is why raising the LM token budget returned only 2.70%
acoustic_batching.note: changes the acoustic forward path; requires a train/infer numerical-consistency acceptance before any throughput claim

reference_actor_overlap.change: score the fixed reference policy for the next step's queries while the actor update is in flight
reference_actor_overlap.reason: the reference policy is frozen, so its scores are policy-independent and safe to prefetch during the ~40 s actor window when the two inference cards idle; hides ~15-17 s/step of reference
reference_actor_overlap.note: distinct from a full-run reference prewarm: a one-shot 40513-query prewarm costs ~1.5 h on one card and roughly breaks even over a 2-epoch run, so overlap (not bulk prewarm) is the candidate

withdrawn_candidate.name: v0.0.5 service-capacity (48q/65536t, gpu_memory_utilization .4->.6)
withdrawn_candidate.reason: central lever (token budget) already measured at 8x for +2.70%; memory-utilization raise unnecessary (131072 fit at .4). Building this package would re-test a disproven lever and be weaker than the tested optimum.
withdrawn_candidate.disposition: the subagent-built packager skeleton (config-driven topology, module closure, fixed-image CPU harness) is retained as reusable infrastructure; the 65536/48 hardcoding and the mem-util transform are dropped

lever_ranking.rule: 2026-11-17 user directive: validate the highest-expected-improvement module first, each validated separately on a 4-card group (2 train + 2 infer)

already_measured_audited.result: 4q/16384t -> 32q/131072t = +2.70% (86.44->84.17 s/step); saturated, withdrawn as a lever
fastest audited arm: 74.76 s/step, +12.58% over service32, saves 940 s/100 steps; status complete_efficiency_evidence_reconstructed
already_measured_audited.source_domain_parity: SLURP TEST exact 2026-11-17: 269 queries x 60 decisions, probability_max_abs=0.0, logit_max_abs=0.0, threshold_flips=0, top1_changes=0; status target_width_macro_parity_outputs_audited; finite panel (full_population_parity=false), parity only (target_scored=false)
already_measured_audited.caveat: MINDS transfer-domain parity not exact (10/259 samples, max prob err 0.0244, logit err 0.21875, top1 change 0); SLURP source-domain TEST parity now exact (269/60, 0 diffs); not a fresh-process-recovery or efficacy claim

remaining_order.hits: reference ~14.96-16.15 s (epoch-1 misses; epoch 2 hits cache)
remaining_order.why_highest_remaining: the actor is already fully batched (collate_span_audio pads+concats into one backbone forward) and microbatch 16 already OOM'd, so actor-loop headroom is low; acoustic batching is done; reference prefetch during the idle ~40 s actor is the clearest remaining win in epoch 1

remaining_order.why_lower: already batched; microbatch increase blocked by OOM; remaining headroom is FSDP all-reduce / python dispatch, uncertain

lever_ranking.separate_task_candidate: template_dedup (~1.2x) is a task-definition change, validated separately
lever_ranking.combined_estimate: adopt acoustic_kv16 (74.76 s) as base, then reference-overlap ~1.1x full-run; 1 hour (8.8x) remains out of reach
lever_ranking.validation_protocol: each remaining module validated separately on a 4-card group (2 train + 2 infer, DP2 + dual TP1); short acceptance 4 inference passes / 2 training updates; all numbers are estimates until measured

efficiency_service.note: SUPERSEDED: capacity is fixed at the already-measured batch32 optimum (32q/131072t, .4); the 48q/65536t/.6 variant is withdrawn per withdrawn_candidate. The owner candidate and config-driven packager skeleton are retained only as reusable infrastructure for a future pipeline/actor candidate; no package, CPU acceptance, NPU run or throughput claim exists.

efficiency_budget.comparison_rule: matched DP2 + dual TP1 run against the batch32 study (32q/131072t, 84.17 s/step) on the same 4 cards, same schedule prefix, same seeds; report the full 100-step curve, not a prefix or a single step. The next candidate must change a NON-capacity lever (actor, acoustic batching or reference/actor overlap), since capacity is already measured at 8x for 2.70%.

before_dispatch: the 4 cards (0-1 train, 2-3 inference) are free; no frozen run occupies them
the next candidate changes actor, acoustic batching or reference/actor overlap (NOT capacity, which is saturated)
fixed-image CPU acceptance for every changed source
task-definition candidate (template dedup) validated separately from the engineering baseline
DP global reduction and 2-update NPU acceptance at DP2 + dual TP1

open_issues: the 1-hour target needs ~8.8x; after the capacity correction the remaining estimated levers (actor+acoustic+overlap) are ~2-3.5x, so 1 hour is very likely unreachable by service tuning alone and the hard floor needs measurement
the acoustic-tower batching lever risks train/infer numerical divergence; it needs a dedicated consistency acceptance, not just throughput
graph capture (enforce_eager=False) is untested on Ascend and is not part of this first candidate
this design does not change the v9 212-update budget and makes no efficacy claim
